home.heroText: Experience the rich legacy of Jaisalmer's craft. Our ghee is handcrafted from the A2 milk of free-grazing Tharparkar cows, slow-churned in traditional earthen handis over a controlled wood fire. Taste the pure, granular texture and unmatched aroma of ancient tradition.
home.videoText: Experience the beautiful, organic lifestyle of our cows. They roam freely in the pure arid environment of Khuri, Jaisalmer, drinking pristine water and grazing naturally.
home.categoriesSub: Premium ghee varieties, each crafted with care and traditional expertise.
home.processTitle: How Our Ghee Is Made: The Vedic Bilona Process
home.processSub: Follow our step-by-step handcrafting journey, perfectly synced with our process video. Click any step to jump to that part!
home.processWatchFlow: process: watch flow at time marker {{time}}.
home.processStep1LongDesc: Fresh milk from our Tharparkar cows is boiled in mitti ki handi (traditional earthen pots) over slow-burning kanda (cow dung cakes) and babool firewood, capturing the true rustic aroma of Rajasthan.
home.processStep2LongDesc: The curd is hand-churned before dawn using a wooden Bilona, rotated clockwise and anti-clockwise to separate the nutrient-rich makkhan (butter) from the buttermilk.
home.processStep3LongDesc: The fresh hand-churned Makhan is placed in a heavy brass/copper Kadhai and slowly heated over a wood fire. The water evaporates, leaving aromatic golden ghee.
home.processStep4LongDesc: Our premium Bilona ghee is filtered and poured into sterile glass jars while warm. We seal in the granular texture and ship it directly to you.
home.testimonialSub: Here's what our happy families say about the pure aroma and quality of Daatasa ghee.
home.t1Comment: This Tharparkar Bilona Ghee smells exactly like the hand-churned ghee my grandmother used to make in Rajasthan. The graininess and the rich aroma are absolutely perfect!
home.t2Comment: Finding genuine, chemical-free ghee from Tharparkar cows is hard. I tested Daatasa myself and the purity from their village process is exceptional.
home.t3Comment: I add Daatasa ghee to my bullet coffee every morning. The traditional village preparation gives sustained energy and the taste is unbelievable.

aboutUs.pageTitle: About Us — Daatasa Pure Bilona Ghee
aboutUs.pageDescription: Learn about Daatasa — our story, the traditional Bilona process, and our promise of 100% pure, natural desi ghee.
aboutUs.heroDesc: Bringing the golden essence of the Thar desert — authentic Bilona ghee straight from Khuri, Jaisalmer.
aboutUs.section1P1: Daatasa was born in Khuri, Jaisalmer — a desert village where time-honored traditions are a way of life. We realized the market was flooded with processed ghee lacking the rich aroma and granularity of true Rajasthani bilona ghee. Our family decided to share our authentic, chulha-cooked Tharparkar cow ghee with the world.
aboutUs.section1P2: We set out to bridge the gap between ancient Vedic wisdom and modern convenience — delivering FSSAI-certified, lab-tested, pure Bilona ghee right to your doorstep. No shortcuts. No additives. Just tradition in every jar.
aboutUs.section2Desc: We strictly follow the ancient Vedic Bilona method — the only method that preserves the true nutritional value of ghee:
aboutUs.section4Desc: Every jar of Daatasa ghee is a commitment — to you, to the cows, and to the planet:
aboutUs.step1Desc: Sourced every morning from our own free-grazing Tharparkar cows foraging in the open desert pastures of Jaisalmer.
aboutUs.step2Desc: Cultured overnight in mitti ki handi, then hand-churned clockwise and anti-clockwise using a traditional wooden bilona.
aboutUs.step3Desc: The makkhan is slow-cooked over a traditional mud chulha using cow dung cakes and babool wood to lock in the rustic aroma.
aboutUs.step4Desc: Every batch passes FSSAI-certified lab tests before dispatch.
aboutUs.promise1: No preservatives, no artificial colours, no hidden chemicals.
aboutUs.promise2: Our Tharparkar cows graze freely on native desert herbs in Jaisalmer and are never injected with hormones.
aboutUs.promise3: Every batch is rigorously lab-tested for purity and safety.
aboutUs.promise4: Delivered fresh in food-safe, tamper-evident packaging.
aboutUs.time1Desc: Our family in Khuri, Jaisalmer, tired of adulterated supermarket ghee, decides to share our authentic desert village ghee.
aboutUs.time2Desc: Our first Bilona ghee is made on the farm — sold out in 3 days.
aboutUs.time3Desc: Daatasa.com goes live. 500 families order in the first month.
aboutUs.time4Desc: After rigorous lab testing, we earn full FSSAI certification.
aboutUs.time5Desc: Now serving 5,000+ families across all major Indian cities.
aboutUs.time6Desc: Launched biodegradable, carbon-neutral packaging across all products.
aboutUs.testimonialComment: The aroma when I open the jar reminds me of my grandmother's village in Rajasthan. You can taste the authenticity of Tharparkar cow milk in every spoonful.

faq.sec1a1: Bilona Ghee is prepared using the traditional Vedic method. Fresh Tharparkar cow milk from our Rajasthan village is boiled, cultured into curd, then hand-churned in wooden vats to extract makkhan (butter). This butter is slow-heated over firewood to produce pure, aromatic ghee, retaining maximum nutrients.
faq.sec1a2: Absolutely. Every batch undergoes rigorous testing in FSSAI-certified laboratories to ensure purity, quality, and compliance with food safety standards. Test reports are available on request.
faq.sec1q3: How should I store the ghee?
faq.sec1a3: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. No refrigeration needed. Always use a clean, dry spoon to prevent moisture from entering the jar.

faq.sec2a3: Yes! A tracking link is emailed to you once your order is dispatched. You can also track it in "My Orders" on your Daatasa account.
